notes: Living data file for the said-bookism dialogue-tag check. Each entry lists exact surface forms deliberately (no stemming) since tag verbs are a small, curatable, closed set. Grow this list as new offenders show up in your own drafts rather than relying on a suffix rule to catch them. Grounded in the Turkey City Lexicon (a science-fiction-workshop craft glossary in continuous use since the 1980s, still the standard reference for this exact term): its own "'Said' Bookism" entry names "retorted," "inquired," and "ejaculated" as its canonical bad examples, all three included below. The Lexicon also names a distinct, related problem, "Tom Swifty" ("said" followed by a colorful adverb, e.g. "she said icily"); that's checked separately in code (adjacent to this data, not driven by it, since it's a structural pattern on the *allowed* verbs rather than a lexicon of banned ones).
